items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: We played together a lot of jobs too.

ctx.x: Yeah, I did. That's right. About two, two weeks ago. I like that. That must be your first parade. You've played in quite a while, isn't it? I don't remember seeing him on a parade.

Well, it is the first one I've played for quite a while. Because a lot of time when mine and the one, the band have a job maybe going out of town. Yeah. So I can't make it. But when he got a parade, he gave me first preference. Yeah. Yeah, I like him for that because he's wonderful, you know. He always think about it. Sure. Well, you see, when I wasn't with Papa Sal's team band, I used to think about him. I used to get a lot of jobs and always called on mine. Sure. Yeah, because he was an okay fella. And really,…
That just about finishes up this reel of tape if there's anything else that you want to add. I think you've covered your life pretty well.
